matches.note: Dehibilitator fell roughly 40 feet through a broken railing in a real-injury-angle finish; no pinfall or toss was ever declared, and the broadcast cut to his being stretchered out. The angle also reveals Dehibilitator's own in-fiction "real name," Arden Pilate, as a kayfabe medical-update detail, and introduces JT Damon, who superkicked Dehibilitator in one interference spot.
